questions.stem: What makes the books easy for visitors to choose?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Clear price labels.”. Evidence: On Friday, every book is on sale at half its usual second-hand price. Clear labels make it easy for visitors to choose what they can afford.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A class runs a book fair to support its library”. Evidence: Our class wants to raise money for new library cushions. At a meeting, we talk about holding a small book fair after lessons. Families bring books they no longer read and help us arrange the tables. On Friday, every book is on sale at half its usual second-hand price. Clear labels make it easy for visitors to choose what they can afford. By the end, most books find new readers and our money box is full. We count the money together and thank every family that helped.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A class runs a book fair to support its library”。原文依据：我们班想筹钱给图书馆添新坐垫。 开会时，我们讨论放学后办一个小书市。 各家带来不再读的书，帮我们摆桌子。 星期五，每本书都按通常二手价的一半降价出售。 清楚的标签便于来客选择买得起的书。 结束时，大部分书找到了新读者，钱箱也满了。 我们一起数钱，感谢每个提供帮助的家庭。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "We are visiting a village when a sudden shower begins. A notice on a wooden cabin says that visitors may ask inside for shelter. I knock at the door, and an old man welcomes our group. We leave our wet coats beside the entrance and explain where we are going. He opens a map and points to a narrow path behind the post office. It leads to the museum without crossing the muddy field. When the rain stops, we thank him and follow his careful directions." This supports the answer: "Shelter and Directions from a Kind Stranger".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：我们参观村庄时，突然下起阵雨。 一间木屋的告示写着，游客可以进屋请求避雨。 我敲门，一位老人欢迎我们一行。 我们把湿外套放在门口，说明要去哪里。 他打开地图，指向邮局后面的一条小路。 这条路通往博物馆，不必穿过泥泞的田地。 雨停后，我们谢过他，按他细致的指引前行。 因此正确选项为“Shelter and Directions from a Kind Stranger”。
